P_to_Te.mechanism: transformer thermal capability -> charger available AC input -> charging service
P_to_Te.required: verified transformer rating, thermal operating limits, feeder-to-EVSE connection, synchronized logs

Te_to_P.mechanism: charging + EVSE cooling power -> transformer loading -> transformer thermal state
Te_to_P.required: metered grid-side AC input and auxiliary, EVSE thermal control, common node and synchronized timestamps

warning: Separate installations cannot be concatenated and represented as observed causal coupling
